newsitem.title: CANADA: Canrise to buy Mobil Canada assets.
newsitem.headline: Canrise to buy Mobil Canada assets.

text.p: Canrise Resources Ltd said it agreed to buy some of Mobil Corp unit Mobil Oil Canada's assets in the McLeod area of Alberta for C$26.45 million.
Canrise said the assets included various interests in 45 sections of Alberta government land, 22 of which are undeveloped.
The acreage included 20 producing gas wells and three capped gas wells, it said.

Canrise said the deal was of strategic importance to the company because it included a 33.3 percent stake in a 21 million cubic feet a day operated gas plant and a 37.5 percent interest in a non-operated facility of the same capacity.

"Overall, the acquisition will allow Canrise to significantly reduce the third-party processing fees it currently pays the plant owners, and also afford Canrise ready processing and market access for its 1997 area drilling program," it said.
Canrise said an independent evaluation of the assets pegged proven marketable reserves at 1.858 million barrels of oil equivalent and probable reserves at 752,000 BOE.

The acreage is adjacent to Canrise's exploration prospects at McLeod and Niton, where it began operations in late 1995. Its properties produce 10 million cubic feet per day of gas and 400 barrels per day of oil from four wells, it said.
Net production from the lands to be purchased was said to be about eight million cubic feet a day of gas and 300 barrels per day of natural gas liquids.
